The space
Welcome to a renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo in a historic 1890s building in Nashville's Arts District. Walk to Broadway, restaurants, stadiums, and the Cumberland River. The home has a full kitchen, dining area, and comfortable living space. Each bedroom has one king bed, a window view, and an en suite full bathroom. Sleeps 4. Please note: there is no elevator and no complimentary parking; use paid street parking or nearby paid garages and lots.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
